snippet.title: Hope in the City - Official Game Overview Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Game Overview Trailer for Hope in the City, a mystery investigation game developed by Lofty Sky Entertainment Inc. Embody the life of Hope Song as she pieces together clues to understand the disappearance of her parents. Uncover dark secrets in Hope in the City, coming soon to PC (Steam).
